title: Many Bonds for the Same Number
objective: The same whole has multiple valid bonds — direct extension of Unit 0.2's multiple decompositions into bond notation.
studentQuestion: How many different bonds can you build for the same whole?

teaching.setup: The whole 7 (same number used in the Unit 0.2 decomposition lesson, deliberately).
teaching.see: You already found every way to split 7 with objects. Can you draw them all as bonds?
teaching.build: Draw a bond for each split.
teaching.transform: Three different bonds, one shared whole — same value, three drawn forms.

check.prompt: Verify each bond's parts sum to 7.

examples.second: 8's full set of splits, as bonds.
examples.transfer: 10's splits, as bonds — directly feeds Unit 1.2/1.3.

mastery.evidence: Produces the complete set of distinct bonds for a whole up to 10.
